'''Viic''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] within a military force serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. For part of the war, Viic was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where they worked in [[Pallista Spaceport]] as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and while at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] they wore brown, red, and yellow [[Robe/Legends|robes]] along with red pants.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viic first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
